The Vice Chancellor for Academic Affairs approves the position details, the vacancy is posted on the UoS HR website and other approved sites, and a hiring committee of at least three members is appointed (2.2.2).  
The committee reviews and evaluates applicants and recommends a candidate, after which the Chancellor gives final approval (2.2.1, 2.2.2).  
Once approved, HR prepares and sends the selected candidate a detailed offer that includes title, salary, contract type, job assignment and UoS information (2.2.3).
